meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按技能文档指导你使用 Python 的 GeoPandas 库处理矢量地理数据:读写 shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage 等格式,执行缓冲、空间连接、叠加、坐标转换、绘制地图等操作,并审计相关代码。
howto.when: 当你处理矢量地理数据,或要求进行空间分析、坐标转换、读写矢量文件等操作时。

say.text: 帮我用 GeoPandas 读取这个 GeoJSON 并画出地图。
say.note: Claude 会给出读取和绘图的代码。

say.text: 把这个 shapefile 重投影到 EPSG:3857 并计算面积。
say.note: Claude 会提供 CRS 转换和面积计算代码。

say.text: 用 sjoin 把点和面做空间连接,统计每个面内的点数。
say.note: Claude 会给出空间连接与聚合的示例。

howto.what_en: Claude will use this skill to guide and audit Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas: reading/writing vector data, geometric operations, spatial joins, overlays, CRS transformations, and mapping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with vector geographic data, e.g. spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformation, spatial joins, overlays, or reading/writing vector data.

say_en.text: Help me read this GeoJSON with GeoPandas and plot it.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the read and plot code.

say_en.text: Reproject this shapefile to EPSG:3857 and compute areas.
say_en.note: Claude will show CRS transformation and area calculation.

say_en.text: Use sjoin to spatially join points to polygons and count points in each polygon.
say_en.note: Claude will give a spatial join and aggregation example.
